text: In Hi-C chromatin architecture analysis, self-interacting chromatin domains identified from genome-wide contact maps are called Topologically Associating Domains, commonly abbreviated ___.
explanation: TADs (Topologically Associating Domains) are self-interacting chromatin regions identified from Hi-C contact maps, distinct from the larger-scale A/B compartments (active vs. inactive chromatin) and from CTCF/cohesin-anchored loops, which represent different levels of genome organization.
